# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-shortcuts-doc.mjs from src/shell/shortcuts.ts.
     Do not edit by hand — change the registry and re-run `npm run gen:shortcuts`. -->

The registry that produces this file also feeds the command palette and every
tooltip, so what you read here is what the app actually binds.
`src/__tests__/shell/shortcuts.test.ts` checks the global entries against the real
handler in both directions, so neither a broken promise nor an undocumented binding
can survive CI.

## View

| Keys | Action | Applies |
|---|---|---|
| `Shift+A` | Fit all to view | Anywhere except a text input. |
| `Shift+F` | Centre on selection | Anywhere except a text input. |
| `Shift+H` | Hide selection | Anywhere except a text input. |
| `Shift+U` | Unhide all | Anywhere except a text input. |

## Panels

| Keys | Action | Applies |
|---|---|---|
| `Shift+Q` | Toggle preferences | Anywhere except a text input. |
| `Shift+T` | Toggle the outliner | Anywhere except a text input. |

## Selection

| Keys | Action | Applies |
|---|---|---|
| `Shift+C` | Copy selected names | Anywhere except a text input. |
| `Shift+Up` | Select parent level | Anywhere except a text input. |
| `Shift+Down` | Select first child | Anywhere except a text input. |
| `Shift+Left` | Select previous sibling | Anywhere except a text input. |
| `Shift+Right` | Select next sibling | Anywhere except a text input. |

## Build

| Keys | Action | Applies |
|---|---|---|
| `Shift+Enter` | Compile preview | Anywhere except a text input. |
| `G` | Move gizmo | Only while a procedural model is open. |
| `R` | Rotate gizmo | Only while a procedural model is open. |
| `S` | Resize gizmo | Only while a procedural model is open. |
| `X` | Lock to X axis | Only while a procedural model is open. |
| `Y` | Lock to Y axis | Only while a procedural model is open. |
| `Z` | Lock to Z axis | Only while a procedural model is open. |
| `Ctrl+Z` | Undo | Only while a procedural model is open. |
| `Shift+Z` | Redo | Only while a procedural model is open. |
| `Enter` | Accept the current move / rotate / resize | Only while a procedural model is open. |
| `Escape` | Step back one layer (cancels an axis-locked move) | Only while a procedural model is open. |

## Gallery

| Keys | Action | Applies |
|---|---|---|
| `Left` | Previous item | Only in gallery mode. |
| `Right` | Next item | Only in gallery mode. |

## Shell

| Keys | Action | Applies |
|---|---|---|
| `Ctrl+K` | Open the command palette | Anywhere. |
| `Ctrl+Shift+P` | Open the command palette | Anywhere. |
